caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass bottle with a stopper, drawn in pencil or graphite. The bottle is tall with a wide base that tapers upward to a narrow neck, which is topped by a decorative, faceted stopper. The surface of the bottle features a textured pattern of diamond-shaped cuts on the lower half, and vertical lines on the base and just below the neck. Around the shoulder of the bottle, the word “BRANDY” is embossed in raised letters. The stopper is round with a faceted surface, matching the diamond pattern on the bottle. The drawing is monochromatic, using only shades of gray, and is enclosed within a rectangular border. The artist’s name, John Dana, appears in the lower left corner of the border.
title: Decanter
